context_requirements: Leukotriene synthesis inhibitors target LTA4H or RNPEP, enzymes in the arachidonic acid/leukotriene pathway; transcriptional response requires active leukotriene synthesis or autocrine/paracrine leukotriene signaling, which is not a core feature of these nine lines under standard culture.
No direct nuclear receptor or transcription factor is engaged, so no immediate transcriptional program is expected.
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h across multiple cell lines.
Enrichment of arachidonic acid or leukotriene pathway gene signatures after treatment.
Shared transcriptional signature with known LTA4H inhibitors or leukotriene receptor antagonists.
